now.heroTitle: Show what you want right now
now.heroBody: This is a momentary status for the next hour: quick, live, and clearly not a marketplace post.
now.myStatusBody: A short nearby pulse, not a structured announcement.
now.roomsCardBody: Rooms shows what is happening nearby, while Together carries the one-on-one path.
now.promptTitle: What do you want right now?
now.placeholder: For example: up for a 20-minute walk / want coffee right now…

nearby.heroBody: Use Now for a quick pulse, Announcements for structured requests, and Rooms for live group context.
nearby.segment.nowBody: A momentary nearby pulse: short status and what you want right now.
nearby.segment.announcementsBody: Structured requests: who you are looking for, where, and for what.
nearby.segment.roomsBody: Group geo-chat with live shared context.
nearby.announcements.title: Announcements nearby
nearby.announcements.body: More explicit posts: who you are looking for, where to meet, and what kind of plan you want.
nearby.announcements.emptyBody: Try another filter or post the first announcement if you are looking for company, a ride, or a more specific plan.

nearby.detail.photoWithBody: The image helps explain the format of the request and the context of meeting up.
nearby.detail.photoWithoutBody: This is a text-first announcement. Everything important is already in the description below.

nearby.rooms.title: Rooms nearby
nearby.rooms.body: A live grouped geo-chat for people around you. Place, timing, and quick entry matter here.

nearby.rooms.featureTwo: People and live context nearby right now
nearby.rooms.featureThree: The full Rooms experience opens on the separate Rooms screen

nearby.create.title: Create announcement
nearby.create.heroBody: This is not a right-now status. Keep it short and clear: who you are looking for, where, and what the plan is for.
nearby.create.photoBody: Optional. You can still publish the announcement without an image.
nearby.create.photoAttachedHint: Your photo is attached. You can check the announcement preview below right away.
nearby.create.titlePlaceholder: For example: Looking for company for an evening walk
nearby.create.descriptionPlaceholder: Who are you looking for, what format do you want, and why is this request relevant right now?
nearby.create.cityPlaceholder: For example: Center, Warsaw, or Mokotow
nearby.create.previewBodyFallback: This is where people will see who you are looking for, where it applies, and why it is worth responding.
nearby.create.previewFooter: Will appear in Nearby -> Announcements as a structured request
nearby.create.fillTitle: The announcement needs a few basics
nearby.create.fillBody: Add a title and a short description so it is clear who you are looking for and why.
nearby.create.publishHint: After publishing, it will appear in Nearby → Announcements as a structured request right away.
rooms.title: Rooms

playDetail.heroHomeTextOpen: This page keeps the shared result, replay, and the path back into your personal conversation. The connection is already open, and the story remains its calm anchor.
playDetail.heroHomeTextWaiting: This page already holds the shared outcome of your session. If the open becomes mutual, the personal conversation will grow from this story.

playDetail.bridgeStoryOnlyBody: The contact did not move into a personal conversation, but the whole shared story stays here with replay, context, and the result between you.
playDetail.bridgeStoryOnlyHint: If you want another chance at continuation, the best next step is a new shared session in Together.
playDetail.replayBody: Replay the full drawing stroke by stroke and return to the moment you built together.

icebreaker.fallback.1: Hi! What's something good about your day?
icebreaker.fallback.2: Hi 😊 How is your day going?
icebreaker.fallback.3: Hey! What would you do if this were an ideal morning?

icebreaker.goal.dating.2: If we had a first date, where would you suggest we go?
icebreaker.goal.friends.1: Hi! Looking for company for what more: coffee, walks, or board games?
icebreaker.goal.friends.2: If we just hung out as friends, what would you suggest doing?
icebreaker.goal.chat.1: Hi! What do you like chatting about the most?
icebreaker.goal.chat.2: If we hung out in chat for an hour, what would we definitely talk about?
icebreaker.goal.long_term.1: Hi! What's most important to you in people nearby?

icebreaker.goal.short_term.2: What helps someone win you over in the first messages?

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.body:
# Privacy Policy — Amoria
Last updated: 2025-08-15

We collect minimal data to provide core features:
- Profile (name, birthdate, gender, interests, goal, mood)
- Location while the app is in use for "people nearby"
- User content (texts, reports, blocks)

No ads, no data selling. You can delete your account in the app.
Contact: support@amoria.app
